subject: Mutual action playbook: HealthWare POC environment setup
messages:
From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@healthware.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jenna Park <jenna.park@healthware.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-18T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: POC kickoff & MAP items (API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering)

Hi Grace —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. We want to move our POC to the next stage and need a compact mutual action plan that covers the environment setup: org/team setup, API key provisioning and rotation, IP allowlist, and VPC peering. Our legal/procurement window is tight, so a 3-week activation target would be ideal.

Can your team draft a playbook that lists owners, required artifacts, and timelines? Also please call out any unblockers from HealthWare. I copied Jenna (Infra) and Vanessa (customer success) who will be the primary contacts from our side.

Attachments: none for now.

Best,
Tom
Tom Ellis
Head of Integrations
HealthWare Inc.

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-18T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & MAP items (API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, VPC peering)

Tom —

Thanks — happy to own the MAP draft. I've sketched an initial playbook and attached a one-sheet roadmap (MAP_Roadmap_HealthWare_v1.xlsx). High level:

- Week 0 (this week): Confirm account and org owners, sign MAP (owner: HealthWare legal + RDW AE).
- Week 1: Provision API keys (short-lived, scoped) and seed demo org; configure IP allowlist entries (owner: HealthWare infra).
- Week 2: Setup VPC peering + test traffic routing; run small perf validation.
- Week 3: Roll acceptance test, finalize support contacts and transfer to CS.

Owners assigned in the sheet: Grace (RDW PM) for overall orchestration, Jonas (RDW infra) for peering and network, Vanessa (RDW CS) for acceptance. We flagged two potential blockers: (1) HealthWare firewall policy review window, and (2) whether you want dedicated or ephemeral API keys for the initial test.

Can you confirm availability for a 45-minute technical preflight with Jonas tomorrow? We'll bring the MAP one-sheet, the environment checklist, and a short VPC peering checklist.

Thanks — I'll wait for Jenna/Tom to confirm blockers and signoff to move the schedule.

—
Grace O'Connor
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: MAP_Roadmap_HealthWare_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet; sheet: Owners & Timeline)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@healthware.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-19T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & MAP items (technical notes on peering & keys)

Adding a few technical constraints from the infra side so we don't get blocked mid-sprint:

- VPC peering: We support cross-account peering (AWS) and peering via cloud router (GCP). We'll need the HealthWare VPC CIDR and a contact who can approve route table changes. Peering creation usually takes ~2 business days plus firewall changes.
- IP allowlist: We recommend a small ephemeral pool for the POC; if you prefer static IPs we can reserve a NAT gateway (additional cost). Please provide a /28 or /27 block you'd allow for initial testing.
- API keys: We'll issue scoped, time-limited keys for the POC (recommended). If you require long-lived keys, we'll add a key rotation policy and an HMAC fingerprinting step.

Proposed preflight items for tomorrow: CIDR blocks, list of firewall approvers, preferred key model (ephemeral vs static), and a quick check on whether mutual TLS is required.

Jonas
Director, Infrastructure Integrations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: none

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@healthware.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & MAP items (security preflight)

Quick security checklist from our compliance team:

- IP allowlist: Request justification for each allowed CIDR and a documented approval path. We'll need source IPs for any scheduled integration tests.
- API key model: Ephemeral scoped keys are preferred. If HealthWare requires persistent keys for automation, we request rotation frequency <= 30 days and logging to an agreed audit stream.
- VPC peering: We'll require an ACL and routing acceptance test plan. Please confirm whether HealthWare expects transitive routing (we strongly discourage it for POC).
- Audit evidence: If procurement asks, we can provide a one-page SOC2 scoping checklist and a sample network diagram. Link to template: https://redwood.sharepoint.com/:x:/s/eng-templates/MAP-template

I'll also add a short step in the MAP for key revocation procedures and an emergency contact list.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Security & Trust, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com

Let's lock the technical preflight for Monday 2026-03-22 10:00 PT. Can Jonas share a link to a short runbook we'll walk through during the call?

- HealthWare: provide CIDR and approver (Jenna)

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.
